sql: select 'policy' tipo, jsonb_build_object('nome', polname, 'cmd', polcmd, 'using', pg_get_expr(polqual, polrelid)) info from pg_policy where polrelid = 'public.campaign_leads'::regclass and polcmd in ('d','*') union all select 'lead', jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'status', status, 'unit', unit, 'created_at', created_at, 'lead_kind', lead_kind) from campaign_leads where company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and whatsapp like '%981121710%' union all select 'papel', jsonb_build_object('email', p.email, 'role', uc.role) from user_companies uc join profiles p on p.user_id = uc.user_id where uc.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and lower(p.email) = 'castelodadiversao@gmail.com' union all select 'conversa', jsonb_build_object('id', w.id, 'lead_id', w.lead_id, 'instance', w.instance_id, 'bot_step', w.bot_step, 'tipo', w.bot_data->>'tipo_evento') from wapi_conversations w where w.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and w.remote_jid like '%981121710%'
